text:
Tess: FYI we're trialing a hybrid pickup + pop-up spot-awards model at the retreat. want to finalize lockers, pickup windows, and approval stickers.
Hank: I can run the pickup table 1012.30. Do we need locked lockers for pre-approved envelopes?
Amira: Yes please. lockers would let remote winners pick up later in the day. How many envelopes are expected?
Tess: Estimate 40 pre-approved envelopes, 60 on-demand nominations.
Rohit: Logistics: we'll reserve 12 small lockers in the hallway. each locker has a numbered tag and a sticky slot for an approval sticker.
Leah: For approval levels: 
- up to $75 manager sign-off
- $76150 director sign-off
- >$150 HR + director approval
Tess: We'll print 100 approval stickers with fields: manager name, amount, date. volunteers attach sticker to envelope.
Hank: Quick question  how do we handle cross-border winners who prefer local vouchers? procurement lead time?
finance-bot: Note: local vouchers require 5 business days for procurement; e-gift cards are instant but may be blocked in some regions. Tag country on the log.
Amira: Could we pre-buy a small set of common local vouchers for EMEA/APAC? small pool of €50/£50/AUD50 so we can hand them same day.
Tess: Good idea. Leah, can you confirm budget allowance?
Leah: Yes we can allocate up to $1,000 for local voucher float. Procurement should approve vendor list by Tuesday.
Rohit: Volunteer plan: 9:3011:30 Hank + Amira; 11:303:30 Tess + Rohit; 13:305:30 Leah + floater.
Tess: We'll mark the lockers with a QR code linking to the pickup sheet. If wifi fails, volunteers use paper log and batch upload.
Hank: I'll bring a tablet with the offline form preloaded. also a small labeler for locker numbers.
Amira: Accessibility: include a neutral pickup option (no staff announcement) and a sealed envelope option.
Leah: Tax note: any award > $100 must include recipient country and be flagged for payroll. finance-bot will auto-tag entries.
finance-bot: Reminder: upload receipts and signed approval stickers to /finance/awards within 5 business days. Missing docs will delay reconciliation.
Tess: Can comms make 3 small signs: "Recognition Pickup", "Quiet Pickup (no mention)", and "Locked Locker Pickup"? A3 size. I'll ping them.
Rohit: Inventory check: 60 envelopes printed, 40 pre-approved labels, 100 stickers, 12 locker tags, 1 lockbox with $200 float.
Hank: For the float: do volunteers need petty cash form filled out on site?
Leah: Yes. Bring petty cash form and a witness signature line. Finance requires original.
Amira: Proposal for no-wifi fallback: paper slip fields: recipient, manager, amount, approval sticker ID, locker number, volunteer name. CSV columns match upload template.
Tess: Action items:
1) Rohit: confirm lockers + labeler  due Mon EOD
2) Leah: procure local voucher float + petty cash approval  due Tue noon
3) Hank: tablet + offline form + morning shift
4) Amira: sealed envelopes + quiet pickup signage
5) Tess: ping comms for signs & create upload folder /docs/events/retreat/hybrid-pickup/
peopleops-bot: Checklist added: /docs/events/retreat/hybrid-pickup-checklist.pdf
Hank: I'll also bring a small laminator for stickers so they survive weather.
Leah: Procurement will post approved vendor codes by Tue morning.
Tess: I'll lock the volunteer roster at 4pm tomorrow. thanks everyone.
Amira: All clear from me, excited to test this. :tada:
